text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both showing modest gains despite extreme fear sentiment, suggesting institutional or steady-handed buying at depressed levels rather than panic capitulation. Bitcoin's dominance at 55.8% reflects continued confidence in the largest asset, while the $55B daily volume remains relatively subdued, indicating conviction isn't yet broadly distributed across the market. The Fear & Greed index rising 12 points over a week despite prices barely moving signals sentiment stabilization—a potential precondition for recovery—though the broader alt market (SOL, BNB lagging BTC's gains) suggests risk appetite hasn't yet returned.
